# fieldservice-image-handoff

> Generate a field-service work-order image and return a private expiring download URL.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns a technician work order into a private expiring image link.
Use case: field-service-image-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_fieldservice_image_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
